name: spreadsheetWriteToCsv
description: Writes the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook to a CSV file. Fields containing the delimiter, a quote or a newline are quoted, with embedded quotes doubled. The fluent member form is writeToCsv(filePath, delimiter) (alias writeCsv).

params.name: filePath
params.description: Path of the CSV file to write.

examples.title: Export the active sheet to CSV
examples.description: Build a small workbook and write it to a CSV file.
